honesty: Simulation on a published H100 SXM profile. Peak-bandwidth copy time is an upper bound, not a predicted wall clock. On identical exact prefixes, Tiny Footprint matches production prefix-cache residency. On rhyming organization with different wording, prefix cache cannot share and Tiny Footprint uses the measured in-process Rhyming Template shared/delta fraction (0.388889 shared org / 0.611111 delta org) as a KV residency hypothesis — not a measured H100 transformer KV compression factor, and not the in-process 84.5% aggregate pasted onto device memory.
